action hold-partnership-concern-meeting refuses up front with check 'Regional Health Network has meeting time available' on actor.components.governance_participant.meeting_time_available, a stock the actor's own activity consumes. Fix with three changes: (1) the action only STARTS the activity (sets a status such as 'driving'), with no check on that stock and no progress or consumption effects; (2) add a process that, every tick while the status is active and the stock is above zero, makes one tick of progress and consumes the stock; (3) add a process that switches the status to a stopped/failed value when the stock is at or below zero, so the actor discovers it by observation.

action activate-unanimously-approved-system refuses up front with check 'Regional Health Network has full deployment readiness' on actor.components.governance_participant.deployment_readiness, a stock the actor's own activity consumes.
